title: 第282章 银雷电芒第281章 魔炎呈威
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
怪老头眼中凶光一闪，
而后也不再废话，直接将手中的蛇头拐杖重重杵在地上。
“咕呱！”
他肩膀上的那只碧绿毒蛤蟆猛地跳到地上，迎风便涨。
眨眼之间，竟然变成了一只足有半个擂台大小的巨蛙。
巨蛙张开血盆大口，大股大股墨绿色的毒瘴从它嘴里喷涌而出，
迅速弥漫了整个擂台。
刺鼻的腥臭味甚至顺着阵法的缝隙飘到了看台上，
熏得前排的观众连连作呕。
老头的身形，却是瞬间隐没在浓郁的毒瘴之中，消失得无影无踪。
李素素站在原地，眉头微皱。
她挥动双拳，刚猛拳风在身前形成一道气墙，
试图将逼近的毒雾吹散。
但那毒雾仿佛有生命一般，被吹散后立刻又聚拢过来，
源源不断，似乎根本无法彻底清除。
“小娃娃，别白费力气了。”
老头阴恻恻的声音从四面八方传来，让人根本无法分辨他的方位。
“老夫这毒瘴，乃是采集南域百种剧毒炼制而成。
只要沾上一点，便会腐蚀真元。
你修为再扎实，今天也得把命留在这里！”

伴随着老头的声音，巨蛙再次发出一声震耳欲聋的蛙鸣。
一条水缸粗细、布满倒刺的猩红长舌，突然从毒雾中弹射而出，
直奔李素素的面门。
李素素冷哼一声，不退反进。
她右拳紧握，拳锋上泛起一层淡淡的真元光芒，
一拳砸在巨蛙的长舌上。
“砰！”
沉闷的撞击声响起。
巨蛙发出一声痛呼，长舌猛地缩了回去。
但李素素的脸色却变了变。
她突然捂住胸口，脚步一个踉跄，连退了三四步才勉强站稳。
原本红润的脸颊，此刻竟然泛起了一层诡异的青黑色。
“怎么？撑不住了？”老头的笑声更加得意。
李素素大口喘着粗气，目光却是扫过周围的毒雾，
而后咬牙切齿道：“老东西……你好卑鄙！”
“兵不厌诈，生死斗哪来的规矩！”
怪老头笑得十分猖狂，
脸上的疙瘩，都在皮肉的带动下，一抖一抖的。
包厢里。
林尘静静的看着下方摇摇欲坠的李素素，
content_en:
The strange old man's eyes flashed fiercely,
Then he stopped talking nonsense and directly slammed the snake-head crutch in his hand onto the ground.
"Gugua!"
The green poisonous toad on his shoulder jumped to the ground and swelled in the wind.
In the blink of an eye, it turned into a giant frog half the size of a ring.
The giant frog opened its bloody mouth, and large jets of dark green poisonous miasma spewed out from its mouth.
It quickly filled the entire arena.
The pungent stench even drifted to the stands along the gaps in the formation.
The smoke made the audience in the front row gag.
The old man's figure instantly disappeared into the thick poisonous miasma and disappeared without a trace.
Li Susu stood there, frowning slightly.
She waved her fists, and the strong wind created a wall of air in front of her.
Trying to blow away the approaching poisonous mist.
But the poisonous mist seemed to be alive. After being blown away, it immediately gathered back.
There is a steady stream of them, and it seems impossible to completely remove them.
"Little baby, don't waste your efforts."
The old man's gloomy voice came from all directions, making it impossible to tell where he was.
“My poisonous miasma is made by collecting hundreds of poisons from the Southern Region.
Just a little bit of it will corrode the true essence.
No matter how solid your cultivation is, you still have to save your life here today! "
Along with the old man's voice, the giant frog once again made a deafening cry.
A long scarlet tongue as thick as a water tank and covered with barbs suddenly shot out from the poisonous mist.
Go straight to Li Susu's face.
Li Susu snorted coldly and advanced instead of retreating.
She clenched her right fist tightly, and a faint light of true energy appeared on the edge of her fist.
He punched the giant frog's long tongue.
"Bang!"
A dull crashing sound sounded.
The giant frog let out a cry of pain and retracted its long tongue.
But Li Susu's expression changed.
She suddenly covered her chest, staggered, and took three or four steps back before she could barely stand still.
The originally rosy cheeks now turned a strange blue-black color.
"What? Can't hold it anymore?" The old man's laughter became even more proud.
Li Susu gasped for breath, but her eyes swept over the poisonous mist around her.
Then he gritted his teeth and said, "Old guy... you are so despicable!"
"Soldiers never tire of deceit. Where are the rules in a life-and-death fight!"
The strange old man laughed very wildly,
The pimples on the face trembled and trembled under the influence of the flesh.
In the box.
Lin Chen quietly looked at the crumbling Li Susu below.
